source.title: [ROADMAP MIGRATION] MyZubster Payments & Bounty Automation
source.body:
# Archivio roadmap migrata da Linear — 24 ottobre 2026

Area: **MyZubster Payments & Bounty Automation**. Questo è un **registro di migrazione**: conserva titoli, stati storici, priorità e riferimenti delle attività, non rappresenta una nuova assegnazione o una conferma indipendente di completamento. GitHub diventa la fonte di coordinamento; le issue operative esistenti restano il luogo in cui discutere e consegnare codice. Nessun nuovo abbonamento Linear richiesto.

| Linear | Stato registrato | Priorità | Titolo attività |
|---|---|---|---|
| [MYZ-61](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-61/reconcile-stripe-and-btc-funding-into-treasury-availability) | In Progress | 1 | Reconcile Stripe and BTC funding into treasury availability |
| [MYZ-184](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-184/myz-ledger-migrate-canonical-persistence-from-local-json-to-durable) | In Progress | 1 | MYZ ledger — migrate canonical persistence from local JSON to durable MongoDB |
| [MYZ-176](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-176/canonical-myz-internal-payments-marketplace-zorgax-legacy-cleanup) | In Progress | 2 | Canonical MYZ internal payments — Marketplace + Zorgax + legacy cleanup |
| [MYZ-181](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-181/pr-1286-merge-gate-ci-vercel-preview-and-documentation-consistency) | In Progress | 2 | PR #1286 merge gate — CI, Vercel preview and documentation consistency |
| [MYZ-177](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-177/myz-ledger-atomic-transfers-history-balance-and-idempotency) | In Review | 2 | MYZ ledger — atomic transfers, history, balance and idempotency |
| [MYZ-179](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-179/zorgax-pay-prodeveloper-plans-with-internal-myz) | In Review | 2 | Zorgax — pay Pro/Developer plans with internal MYZ |
| [MYZ-64](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-64/enable-production-bounty-settlement-automation-and-monitoring) | Todo | 2 | Enable production bounty settlement automation and monitoring |
| [MYZ-60](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-60/connect-approved-bounties-to-automatic-myz-ledger-credit) | Todo | 1 | Connect approved bounties to automatic MYZ ledger credit |
| [MYZ-63](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-63/execute-controlled-low-value-xmr-bounty-payout) | Todo | 1 | Execute controlled low-value XMR bounty payout |
| [MYZ-62](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-62/configure-and-validate-monero-rpc-settlement-staging) | Todo | 1 | Configure and validate Monero RPC settlement staging |
| [MYZ-182](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-182/define-migration-policy-for-legacy-myz-credits-and-contributor) | Todo | 3 | Define migration policy for legacy MYZ credits and contributor identity mapping |
| [MYZ-180](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-180/remove-legacyshadow-myz-balances-and-automatic-eur-myz-crediting) | Done | 2 | Remove legacy/shadow MYZ balances and automatic EUR → MYZ crediting |
| [MYZ-178](https://linear.app/myzubster/issue/MYZ-178/marketplace-buyer-seller-payment-with-internal-myz) | Done | 2 | Marketplace — buyer → seller payment with internal MYZ |

## Regole di gestione
- Non presumere che lo stato Linear coincida con lo stato del codice: verificare PR, test, review ed evidenze su GitHub.
- Non creare nuovi ticket per attività già presenti su GitHub: collegare le issue e PR esistenti.
- Volontari scelgono incarichi con opt-in; nessuna ricompensa o spesa è approvata automaticamente.
- Questo indice non riproduce commenti, allegati o materiali sensibili dell'archivio originale.
